_about: What the game shouts for each funny moment ({n} = how many grown-ups a Domino floored), and a line for the highlight reel later.

domino.reel: One prank, {n} grown-ups on the floor.

mannequin.reel: Stood still as a mannequin, right under the guard's nose.

lastSecond.reel: Out the door at the very last second.

oneKid.reel: Got away with just one kid left in the coat.

sugarRush.reel: The Giggle meter is full: Sugar Rush for everyone!

firstSoak.reel: A grown-up, soaked to the socks.

peelSlip.reel: The oldest trick in the book.
